scope: BTC research only; simulated execution, no orders
approval: Merge of the implementing PR approves these frozen rules. Registration requires observation on origin/main; the first opportunity is the next UTC hour. No historical launch.
prior_exposure: PS1 history, range coverage and candidate wider-band replays were inspected before design. All prior data is discovery/training only, never confirmatory evidence for these studies.

turnover.sizing_and_costs: Use frozen PS1 calibration, unlevered spot sizing, ordinary/stressed costs and captured-book fill arithmetic; independent starting cash 100000 per arm/scenario.
turnover.primary: duration-weighted stressed-cost log-return Sharpe(B2_10) minus Sharpe(B2_05)
turnover.secondary: ordinary-cost contrast; B2_10 minus VOL_10; return, drawdown, risk, exposure, turnover and costs
turnover.missing: All arms hold together; skipped slots extend the next closed interval. Last interval stays open. No synthetic exit. Quotes requested strictly after decision confirmation.
turnover.review: Descriptive only before 365 days and 20 blocks. Support requires stressed primary 90% block interval above zero, >=80% scheduled coverage, both B2 volatilities 10%-20%, and B2_10 drawdown no more than 2 percentage points worse. No automated promotion.

range.update: Once per UTC day using only verified, eligible 24h RC1D scores whose horizon and scored time precede midnight. Retain exact training IDs/hashes and residuals.
range.calibration: Add empirical 0.10 quantile of (realized-q10) to q10 and empirical 0.90 quantile of (realized-q90) to q90. Order against unchanged q50; clamp lower to zero. Empirical quantile uses linear interpolation at (n-1)*p. Point forecast unchanged.
range.primary: paired mean 80% interval score(calibrated)-score(B2); width+10*lower miss+10*upper miss in ln(H/L) units, lower is better
range.secondary: coverage and interval width; 4h/72h not tested in this version
range.publication: Both forecasts must be confirmed before the same original RC1D window starts. Warmup/missing/late slots remain in the denominator.

state.fit: Daily logistic regression, standardize and clip to +/-5 training SD, 200 full-batch gradient steps, learning rate 0.1, L2 penalty 0.1 excluding intercept. Same jointly eligible training and evaluation rows for all models; no tuning.
state.primary: Brier(full)-Brier(price/vol baseline) on hourly 4h direction outcomes
state.secondary: baseline+flow, baseline+flow+positioning; event/ordinary strata. Ties count as non-up. Complete 240-minute outcome path required.
state.training: Historical as-of panel permitted for training only, marked discovery. Outcomes must have matured and arrived before midnight; training ends at cutoff-4h30m. Models and member hashes retained before predictions.

paired.clock: Concurrent requests for the same five closed 1m bars ending at the scheduled slot. Original entry is ceil(perp receipt +5m) to next minute; synchronized entry ceil(max receipts +5m). All arms must be published before the earliest entry. Minute-price proxies cannot resolve subminute latency; report equal-entry share.
paired.signal: (2*taker_buy_volume-volume)/volume, threshold +/-0.15. Combined uses summed spot/perp volume and signed flow. Missing/invalid source or >5s receipt gap: joint abstention with separate timeout state.
paired.primary: 60m Brier(combined)-Brier(perp) at synchronized clock; probabilities 0.75 up, 0.25 down, 0.5 abstention. No trade-return claim.
paired.secondary: 15m paired Brier and original-vs-synchronized-clock contrast; conditional hit rates accompanied by all-slot coverage

options.filters: Unchanged research_tools.options_skew.FILTERS; record each leg's age, relative spread, OI, delta distance, available size, rejection reasons and per-expiry usable pair; 7d/30d measures and 50-70m changes only with valid bracketing expiries.

liquidations.mode: revision diagnostic, never replace first-seen predictors
liquidations.signal: sign(long liquidation contracts-short liquidation contracts), eligible only if complete source pagination and total >=1000 contracts; compare flips, size and eligibility across vintages
liquidations.coverage: OKX public BTC-USDT-SWAP filled liquidations only; not market-wide or guaranteed all venue events. Missing/truncated requests are unknown, never zero.

stress.mode: availability/variation pilot only; no predictive test
stress.meaning: Symbol-level low/medium/high ADL risk updated every 30m, not ADL events; insurance may be a shared-symbol pool. Preserve raw responses, source and receipt clocks.

inference: Fixed primary per study. Moving-block paired bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 20261024; no intervals below the minimum blocks, no optional stopping or automated supported status. Retain every scheduled opportunity, missing, abstained, late and pending. No inference for pilots.
